title: Singly linked list
hints: `Push` is one line: `return &Node{Val: v, Next: head}`. `Len` and `ToSlice` use the standard loop `for n := head; n != nil; n = n.Next`.
`FromSlice`: start with `var head *Node` and push the values from the **last** to the first, so the first value ends up in front.

`Reverse` walks with two pointers, `prev` (starts nil) and `cur` (starts at head). Each step: save `next := cur.Next`, set `cur.Next = prev`, then `prev, cur = cur, next`. When `cur` is nil, `prev` is the new head.
